name: DUMB
description: DUMB is a benchmark for evaluating Dutch language models across nine diverse tasks, including four novel tasks for Dutch. It introduces a Relative Error Reduction metric to compare model performance against a strong baseline, facilitating consistent evaluation of Dutch models.
reputation: Includes a public leaderboard and has been used to evaluate 14 pre-trained Dutch language models.
notes: Includes low-, medium-, and high-resource tasks; proposes Relative Error Reduction (RER) metric; highlights underperformance of current Dutch monolingual models.
